examples.text: na te bījaṃ pavapanti, na'pi nīyanti naṅgalā, akaṭṭhapāk'imaṃ sāliṃ, paribhuñjanti mānusā.

82894.commentary: (DNa) hiri netti ca mandiyo'ti hiri ca netti ca mandiyo ca.

examples.text: gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.
gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

82896.meaning1: fire for those worthy of offerings; i.e. mother and father
82896.commentary: (ANa) āhuneyy'aggī'ti-ādīsu pan'ettha āhunaṃ vuccati sakkāro, āhunaṃ arahantī'ti āhuneyyā. mātāpitaro hi puttānaṃ bahupakārattā āhunaṃ arahanti, tesu vippaṭipajjamānā puttā niray'ādīsu nibbattanti. tasmā kiñ'c'āpi mātāpitaro na anuḍahanti, anuḍahanassa pana paccayā honti. iti anuḍahan'aṭṭhen'eva āhuneyy'aggī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: katamo ca, brāhmaṇa, āhuneyy'aggi? idha, brāhmaṇa, yassa te honti mātā'ti vā pitā'ti vā, ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, āhuneyy'aggi.

82897.commentary: (ANa) gahapatī'ti pana gehasāmiko vuccati, so mātugāmassa sayana-vatth'ālaṅ'kār'ādi-anuppadānena bahupakāro. taṃ aticaranto mātugāmo niray'ādīsu nibbattati. tasmā so'pi purimanayen'eva anuḍahan'aṭṭhena gahapat'aggī'ti vutto.

examples.text: idha, brāhmaṇa, yassa te honti puttā'ti vā dārā'ti vā dāsā'ti vā pessā'ti vā kammakarā'ti vā, ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, gahapat'aggi. tasm'āyaṃ gahapat'aggi sakkatvā garuṃ katvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.

82898.meaning1: fire for those worthy of gifts; i.e. priests and ascetics
82898.commentary: (ANa) tasmā so'pi purimanayen'eva anuḍahan'aṭṭhena gahapat'aggī'ti vutto. dakkhiṇeyy'aggī'ti ettha pana dakkhiṇā'ti cattāro paccayā, bhikkhusaṅgho dakkhiṇeyyo. so hi gihīnaṃ tīsu saraṇesu pañcasu sīlesu dasasu sīlesu mātāpitupaṭṭhāne dhammika-samaṇabrāhmaṇ'upaṭṭhāne'ti evam'ādīsu kalyāṇadhammesu niyojanena bahupakāro. tasmiṃ micchāpaṭipannā gihī bhikkhusaṅghaṃ akkositvā paribhāsitvā niray'ādīsu nibbattanti. tasmā so'pi purimanayen'eva anuḍahan'aṭṭhena dakkhiṇeyy'aggī'ti vutto.

examples.text: idha, brāhmaṇa, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā parappavādā paṭiviratā khantisoracce niviṭṭhā ekam'attānaṃ damenti, ekam'attānaṃ samenti, ekam'attānaṃ parinibbāpenti, ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, dakkhiṇeyy'aggi.

82899.meaning1: skill in improvement; expertise in benefit
82899.commentary: (VISM) āyo nāma vuddhi, sā duvidhā anatthahānito atth'uppattito ca. tattha kosallaṃ āyakosallaṃ.

examples.text: tīṇi kosallāni, āyakosallaṃ, apāyakosallaṃ, upāyakosallaṃ.
